project_type: Flutter 3.41.9 / Dart 3.11 mobile app, package habit_tracker, clean architecture (presentation -> domain <- data), flutter_bloc + go_router + get_it + freezed, Firebase (Firestore + anonymous auth) backend. Single repo at /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment, NO worktree.
build_system: flutter pub get; freezed codegen via `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` (*.freezed.dart files live next to sources); android debug APK via `flutter build apk --debug`. analysis_options.yaml excludes design_reference/**, **/*.freezed.dart, lib/firebase_options.dart.
test_framework: flutter_test + bloc_test + mocktail + fake_cloud_firestore. Baseline: 356 passing tests, `flutter analyze` clean. Widget tests render with the Ahem test font (1em per glyph, so layouts must survive very wide text). Many widget tests pump a bare MaterialApp without AppTheme, so `context.tokens` must keep a fallback to the built-in token set.
test_command: flutter test   (architecture check alone: flutter test test/architecture_test.dart)
verification_instructions: After each FEAT: dart format ., flutter analyze (no issues), flutter test (all green; report the count), flutter test test/architecture_test.dart. After FEAT-004 additionally the on-device checklist in plan.md section 10 with screenshots in /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment/screenshots and notes in .agents/tasks/verification.md.
snapshot_or_generated_files: lib/features/habits/domain/entities/habit_with_status.freezed.dart is regenerated by build_runner in FEAT-001 (commit-free, just leave it regenerated). pubspec.lock is updated by `flutter pub get` / `flutter pub remove phosphor_flutter`. No golden/snapshot tests exist.
environment_constraints: Do NOT run `git commit` (or push/reset/checkout). No git worktree: use the absolute paths under /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment. The git repo root is the home directory, so `git status` output is noisy with unrelated projects; scope it with `git status --short -- /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment`. Required device 10BF3A1CM30013Z was NOT connected at planning time (only emulator-5554); follow the fallback rule in plan.md section 10 and say plainly which device was used. In zsh, `echo ===` fails (`=` expansion), quote such strings. Large command output is truncated at 30k chars: pipe through `tail`/`head`. Network downloads for fonts use curl -fSL and must be verified with `file` and `xxd -l 4`.
contribution_requirements: Do not change lib/features/habits/data, repository interfaces, lib/core/{error,time,usecase,auth}, lib/core/di (only the one WatchTodayOverview registration line), bloc public events/states, or design_reference/**. presentation must not import data/ or Firebase (test/architecture_test.dart). Existing tests must be UPDATED to the new UI, never deleted or weakened; every removed test case must be listed with a reason in .agents/tasks/test-changes.md. Do not add intl, google_fonts (unless fonts cannot be bundled), flutter_riverpod. Lints: prefer_single_quotes, prefer_const_constructors, prefer_const_declarations, unawaited_futures (wrap HapticFeedback in unawaited), always_declare_return_types, avoid_print.
key_patterns: Tokens via `context.tokens` (AppTokens ThemeExtension in lib/core/theme/app_tokens.dart) with `tokens.text`, `tokens.space`, `tokens.radii`. Animation durations always via `AppMotion.of(context, d)` (lib/core/theme/app_motion.dart) so reduced motion = zero; `reduceMotion(context)` helper. Pages are BlocConsumer-based with one-shot `actionFailure` states and listenWhen filters. go_router pages built with `buildAppPage` (lib/core/router/app_transitions.dart). Use cases are classes with `call`, built in DI (lib/core/di/injection.dart). WatchHabitDetail is the pattern for using StreakCalculator in a use case. Test helpers: test/helpers/{builders,fakes,pump_app}.dart (`themedApp`, `useSmallPhone`, `buildHabit`, `FixedClock`).
directory_structure: lib/core/{theme,router,di,error,time,usecase,auth,data}; lib/features/habits/{domain/{entities,repositories,services,usecases},data/{datasources,models,repositories},presentation/{bloc/{today,habit_detail,add_habit},pages,widgets,utils}}; test mirrors lib plus test/helpers; assets/fonts holds bundled fonts; design_reference/new_ui is the read-only prototype spec (not part of the build); .agents/tasks holds plan + FEAT artifacts; screenshots/ is created in FEAT-004.
